stem_md: 设 $f(x,y)$ 连续，交换二次积分 $\int_0^a dy\int_{-y}^{\sqrt y}f(x,y)dx\ (a>0)$ 的积分次序[\quad]
search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 连续，交换二次积分 $\int_0^a dy\int_{-y}^{\sqrt y}f(x,y)dx\ (a>0)$ 的积分次序[\quad] $\int_0^a dx\int_{-x}^{\sqrt x}f(x,y)dy$ $\int_{-a}^0dx\int_{-x}^af(x,y)dy+\int_0^{\sqrt a}dx\int_{x^2}^af(x,y)dy$ $\int_{-a}^0dx\int_{-\sqrt x}^af(x,y)dy+\int_0^{\sqrt a}dx\int_{x^2}^af(x,y)dy$ $\int_{-a}^0dx\int_{-x}^af(x,y)dy+\int_0^{\sqrt a}dx\int_{x^2}^af(x,y)dy$ 解答 原式=$\int_{-a}^{0}dx\int_{-x}^{a}f(x,y)dy+\int_0^{\sqrt{a}}dx\int_{x^2}^{a}f(x,y)dy$。
